figures.evidence: The premise '1200 Hz, its fastest rate with CHP = 0' is wrong. Table XV gives CHP 0, SKIP 0: SF 2048 to 150, 150 Hz to 2.048 kHz; SKIP 1 up to 7.6 kHz. Table III lists sample rates only. Normal-mode settling is 25 outputs (20.8 ms at 1200 Hz), so about 12.2 ms at 2.048 kHz; noise above 1200 Hz is not tabulated. SKIP mode, 20 mV range, SF 1536 (200 Hz), CHP 0 gives 200 nV RMS (datasheet text, below 0.34 µV), settled by the sinc3 alone. 210 nV and 20.8 ms at 1200 Hz read correctly. Step settling is not shown to fail for one channel a part (3 placements, JLCPCB C488325 321 ≥ gate 75). Whether it passes is not read
